ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by task fit. This is a closed-form math word problem with a single correct answer and clear completion criteria — exactly the "well-specified retrieval, extraction, and reformatting" family that Lapwing self-reports as its top-rated tasks. The two models are statistically tied on all relevant capability evals (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, and the under-2-point internal eval gaps), so capability didn't break the tie. Matching the query to the model that prefers this kind of bounded, definite-answer work was the deciding factor. The friendly tone is irrelevant here since neither model's preferences are affected in a way that favors one over the other for this task.
